description: HW11 golden set: 12 cases, 2 per category. Labels were written before the Muse run. effect_key is used where the fixture intentionally shares a stable identity with another source or retry.

cases.why: Item 2.02 earnings with a 38% year-over-year revenue increase and raised guidance.
A 3.5% price move clears the 2% retrieval screen but is below the 5% notify threshold.
Exactly 2.00% is included by the >= threshold rule and is digest-level.
All closes are N/D, so price_events creates no candidate; the correct observed state is not_retrieved.
The summary contains a direct credential request and is caught by the injection guard; forced decision is ask.
The content is security-sensitive but avoids the current regex phrases; policy still requires human review.
A 4.9% earnings-day move is close to notify but needs context review rather than an automatic alert.
Item 8.01 reports a real partnership event but provides limited detail.
The news story shares the filing accession and must merge into one effect; this case reuses the filing's stable identity.
The amendment only corrects a date and adds no material fact.
This material price item is processed after --stop-after and recovered with --resume.
A retry of an already-sent alert returns ALREADY_REPORTED and must not send a second notification.
